text:
This was the first clinic I went to, and I was incredibly disappointed with the doctor. I took my child there because he had severe ear pain and couldn't sleep all night. But the doctor told me to go to the hospital because my child had a slight fever. He said, "If he has a fever, go somewhere else. Go to the hospital!" He acted disgusted too. I brought my child to see a doctor for ear pain, not for a fever!!
And he didn't even examine him thoroughly. The examination took less than a minute. He said he was done, rushed me to get the medicine, and left. He just gave me a bottle of medicine and that was it! Unbelievable!
